exit 0
--- stdout
wezterm-stub: started
--- stderr
Created adversarial-pairing blackboard: <PROJECT>/notes/new-board.md
wezterm-stub: notice
--- invocations
== wezterm
arg 1: start
arg 2: --class
arg 3: liza-adversarial
arg 4: --workspace
arg 5: liza-adversarial
arg 6: --cwd
arg 7: <PROJECT>
arg 8: --
arg 9: /bin/sh
arg 10: -lc
arg 11: set -e
wezterm_liza_send_prompt() {
pane_id="$1"
prompt="$2"
(
sleep 2
printf '%s' "$prompt" | wezterm cli --class 'liza-adversarial' send-text --no-paste --pane-id "$pane_id"
printf '\r' | wezterm cli --class 'liza-adversarial' send-text --no-paste --pane-id "$pane_id"
) &
}
pane_id_1=$(wezterm cli --class 'liza-adversarial' split-pane --right --cwd '<PROJECT>' -- 'claude')
wezterm_liza_send_prompt "$pane_id_1" '$adversarial-pairing reviewer-claude <PROJECT>/notes/new-board.md'
wezterm_liza_send_prompt "$WEZTERM_PANE" '$adversarial-pairing doer <PROJECT>/notes/new-board.md yolo'
exec 'claude'
